Rust continues to expand beyond systems programming into web backends, embedded firmware, and WebAssembly tooling. The release of the Rust 2024 edition brought cleaner lifetime elision rules and improved async trait support, addressing two of the most common friction points for newcomers. The Axum web framework, maintained by the Tokio team, has stabilised its API and is seeing wide adoption for services that require both high throughput and memory safety guarantees. Cargo's workspace resolver improvements also reduced compilation times significantly for large monorepos.
